title: Departure.
description:
FEATURES• Minimalist Art Style
• A short game intended to be finished in under an hour
• A variety of environments and possible experiences
• Casual Gameplay with no skill-based mechanics

Об игре

TIMEOUT.
A dreaded prospect on a cold and rainy night. The toys scattered around the room are sure to help you pass the time. 

Journey to faraway lands, through the power of your imagination. Discover lost knowledge and keep an eye out for the elusive clue here and there.

Use your inquisitive nature to find solutions and secrets that can help you on your quest to crack the door's five locks and be free of your confinement in this simple, yet unorthodox, adventure, puzzle solver.
description_short: Close your eyes, explore your imagination, and make your own fun using the toys scattered around your room. Find solutions and secrets that can help you on your quest to crack the door's five locks and be free of your confinement in this simple, adventure, puzzle solver.
